response.sql: SELECT AVG(rebrate / feerate) as avg_rebate_fee_ratio, COUNT(*) as fee_record_count FROM fees WHERE feerate > 0.0009 AND rebrate IS NOT NULL AND feerate IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: "Ignoring missing values" means excluding rows where either rebrate or feerate is NULL, since both are required to calculate the ratio.
The feerate > 0.0009 filter prevents division by zero; no additional NULL-check on feerate is strictly necessary for the math, but both columns are checked to respect data quality.

alternatives.interpretation: Only rebrate is treated as potentially missing; feerate is always present (and strictly > 0.0009 by filter). Exclude only where rebrate is NULL.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(rebrate / feerate) as avg_rebate_fee_ratio, COUNT(*) as fee_record_count FROM fees WHERE feerate > 0.0009 AND rebrate IS NOT NULL;
